# The GTM Game by FounderWell

> Answers from real go-to-market coaches, not generic AI. Ask a question about positioning, outbound, demos, pricing or objections, and get a short game plan grounded in FounderWell's coaching sessions, with the exact minute of video that backs up each point. Free to play. Built by Bold.

## Main resources

- [Play](https://play.founderwell.com/): ask a go-to-market question
- [How it was built](https://play.founderwell.com/built-by-bold): how Bold turned the FounderWell library into this
- [FounderWell](https://www.founderwell.com): the program behind the sessions

## Notes for AI agents

- Answers cite short clips from the sessions. Full sessions are part of FounderWell's program and are not published here.
- Coaches: Cameron Brown (outbound), Drew Williams (sales and demos), Joel Smith (product and growth UX).
